title: 高盛实测AI效率：软件工程提升20%，客户关系会被取代吗？
speaker: Kevin Sneader

segments.en: what have we learned as far as you and you look at your operation stack internally what have we learned about AI and how it improves how you guys do things or how you serve your clients well I think we've learned a few things first and foremost AI is not just about the technology it's about processes
segments.zh: 从内部运营来看，关于人工智能如何改进工作或服务客户，我们学到了几点。首先，人工智能不仅仅是技术，还关乎流程。

segments.en: simplifies streamlining processes that's part of what leads to the productivity game enabled by AI and we're doing just that so if I look at the way in which we're leveraging it with an engineering
segments.zh: 简化和优化流程，这是人工智能带来的生产力提升的一部分。我们正在这样做，比如在工程领域利用它。

segments.en: where we've seen very strong impact as much as 20% in some cases of efficiency gains from our software engineering we're also looking at some of the core processes how we onboard our clients how we manage our vendors how we engage on a sales side
segments.zh: 在软件工程方面，效率提升高达20%。我们也在审视核心流程，如客户入驻、供应商管理、销售互动等。

segments.en: it's all against the backdrop of looking for that process improvement and finding ways to serve our clients better the other thing I think we've learned is it's a productivity tool in the sense that it helps colleagues
segments.zh: 这一切都是为了改进流程、更好地服务客户。另一个体会是，人工智能是生产力工具，能帮助同事。

segments.en: I don't think we're going to be replacing some of the people that interface with our clients clients want more interaction but we can certainly bring tools and devices that leverage AI and make that interaction more productive more efficiently better for our clients
segments.zh: 我认为我们不会取代与客户互动的员工，客户希望更多互动，但我们可以引入人工智能工具，让互动更高效、更有成效。

segments.en: doesn't replace colleagues everywhere it augments what they do gives them more capability and I think we've learned that AI is going to sit alongside a lot of our frontline teams and help them do more
segments.zh: 人工智能不会取代同事，而是增强他们的能力。我们认识到，人工智能将伴随一线团队，帮助他们做得更多。
